title: AI Is Dead. Organoids Are Alive
summary: Muotri’s organoids contain 5 million cells, of which 2.5 million are neurons. (The rest are non-neural glial cells, which serve as scaffolding.) This, he reassures me, is the size of a bee’s brain.
